name: Patrolling Mobs
description: Walking enemies that pace a surface, turn at walls and at the edge of what they are standing on, and resolve contact with the player by where it happened: from above is a stomp, from anywhere else is a hit. It emits world.hazardEntered for the hit rather than an event of its own, which is the whole point — a mob touching you IS a hazard being entered, and reusing the event means every listener that already handles spikes handles mobs too, with nothing rewired. A catalogue that invents an event per source ends up with events nobody listens to; this one has too many of those already.

inputs.name: spawns
inputs.description: Where the mobs start, each {x, y, facing}. Required with no default: mobs nobody placed are not a sensible empty level, they are an unconfigured one. `facing` is -1 or 1 and defaults to 1.

inputs.name: speed
inputs.description: Patrol speed in world units per second. Well under a player's run speed on purpose — a mob you cannot outrun is a wall, not an enemy.

inputs.name: turnsAtLedges
inputs.description: Whether a mob turns around at the edge of its surface. False lets them walk off, which is a different enemy: one that falls into the pit you were saving for yourself.

inputs.name: mobSize
inputs.description: Square footprint in world units. Smaller than the player, so the size difference reads as 'this is the thing I jump on'.

inputs.name: stompable
inputs.description: Whether landing on a mob from above defeats it. False makes every contact a hit, which turns the mob from an obstacle into a hazard that walks.

inputs.name: stompBounceVelocity
inputs.description: Upward speed given to whoever stomps a mob. A little under a normal jump, so a stomp reads as a bounce rather than as a free extra jump.

inputs.name: hitCooldownSeconds
inputs.description: How long before the same mob can hit again. Same reason as a hazard volume's: contact is tested every frame, so without it one touch is sixty hits.

outputs.name: mobs
outputs.description: Live state per mob — position, facing, and whether it is still alive.
